decision.explanation: The original sources provide three distinct death dates for individuals named James Scudamore, each referring to a different person with the same name. Document D1S1 and D2S1 describe James Scudamore, 3rd Viscount Scudamore, who died on 2 December 1716. Document D3S1 and D5S6 describe another James Scudamore, who died on 18 June 1668. Document D6S1 and D7S1 describe yet another James Scudamore, who died in 1619. These are distinct valid answers for their respective referents.
